head a company: After working at the firm for twenty years, she was finally chosen to head a company with over five thousand employees.
在公司工作二十年後，她終於被選中領導一家擁有五千多名員工的公司。
head for the exit: As soon as the fire alarm rang, everyone in the theater stood up and began to head for the exit calmly.
火災警報一響，戲院裡的每個人都站起來，開始冷靜地走向出口。
head off a crisis: The government acted quickly to head off a crisis by lowering interest rates before more banks could fail.
政府迅速行動，在更多銀行倒閉之前降低利率，以避免危機發生。
head the list: Safety concerns head the list of complaints that parents have made about the old school buildings this year.
安全問題在今年家長對老舊校舍所提出的抱怨中名列第一。
head the ball: The tall striker jumped higher than the defenders to head the ball into the corner of the net.
那位高個子前鋒跳得比後衛還高，用頭槌把球頂進球門角落。
head home: After the movie ended, we were so tired that we decided to head home instead of going out for dessert.
電影結束後，我們累到決定回家，而不是出去吃甜點。
heal the wounds: It took many years for the two families to heal the wounds caused by the long fight over their land.
這兩個家庭花了許多年，才療癒因長期土地爭執所造成的傷痛。
heal a rift: The coach invited both players to dinner, hoping to heal a rift that had been hurting the whole team.
教練邀請兩位球員共進晚餐，希望修補一直在傷害整個球隊的裂痕。
time heals: People often say that time heals all wounds, but some painful memories stay with us for life.
人們常說時間治癒一切傷口，但有些痛苦的回憶會伴隨我們一生。
heal the division: The new president promised to heal the division between rich and poor that had grown deeper over the years.
新總統承諾要彌合多年來日益加深的貧富分裂。
heap praise on: The critics continued to heap praise on the young director, calling her latest film a true masterpiece.
影評人持續對這位年輕導演大加讚揚，稱她最新的電影是一部真正的傑作。
heap blame on: Instead of admitting his own mistakes, the manager tried to heap blame on his staff for the failed project.
那位經理沒有承認自己的錯誤，反而試圖把失敗計畫的責任大肆怪罪到員工身上。
heaps of time: Relax, we still have heaps of time before the train leaves, so let's grab a coffee first.
放輕鬆，火車開走前我們還有很多時間，所以先去買杯咖啡吧。
heap scorn on: Some people like to heap scorn on new ideas before they even take the time to understand them.
有些人喜歡在花時間理解新想法之前，就先對它們大加嘲諷。
the debate heated up: As more students shared angry opinions, the debate heated up and voices grew louder until the teacher stepped in.
隨著越來越多學生發表憤怒的意見，辯論白熱化，聲音越來越大，直到老師出面制止。
heated argument: The two neighbors had a heated argument about the noise, shouting at each other for nearly an hour.
這兩位鄰居為了噪音問題發生激烈爭論，互相吼叫了將近一小時。
heat up leftovers: When I am too busy to cook, I usually heat up leftovers in the microwave and eat them at my desk.
當我忙到沒時間煮飯時，我通常會用微波爐加熱剩菜，然後在書桌前吃。
in the heat of the moment: He said some cruel things in the heat of the moment, but he apologized as soon as he calmed down.
他一時衝動說了一些傷人的話，但一冷靜下來就馬上道歉了。
herd the children onto the bus: At the end of the field trip, the teachers tried to herd the children onto the bus before it started to rain.
校外教學結束時，老師們試著在下雨前把孩子們趕上車。
herd cattle: On the large ranch, cowboys on horses still herd cattle across the open fields every morning.
在那座大牧場上，騎馬的牛仔每天早上仍會在開闊的田野上放牧牛群。
follow the herd: Instead of thinking for themselves, many teenagers follow the herd and buy whatever their friends are buying.
許多青少年不自己思考，而是盲從，朋友買什麼他們就跟著買什麼。
hesitate to ask: Many shy students hesitate to ask questions in class because they are afraid of looking foolish in front of others.
許多害羞的學生不好意思在課堂上問問題，因為他們害怕在別人面前顯得愚蠢。
don't hesitate to contact: If you have any questions about your order, please don't hesitate to contact our customer service team by email.
如果您對訂單有任何疑問，請隨時透過電子郵件聯絡我們的客服團隊。
hesitate before answering: When the reporter asked about his future plans, the actor seemed to hesitate before answering the question.
當記者問起他未來的計畫時，那位演員回答前似乎有些遲疑。
highlight the problem: The recent floods highlight the problem of poor drainage in the older neighborhoods of our city.
最近的水災凸顯了我們城市老舊社區排水不良的問題。
highlight the importance: Teachers often use real-life stories to highlight the importance of honesty to their young students.
老師們常用真實生活中的故事，向年幼的學生強調誠實的重要性。
highlight the text: Use a yellow pen to highlight the text that you think will most likely appear on the final exam.
用黃色螢光筆標記你認為最可能出現在期末考的文字。
the highlight of the trip: Watching the sunrise from the top of Jade Mountain was definitely the highlight of the trip for all of us.
從玉山山頂看日出，對我們所有人來說無疑是這趟旅程的亮點。
